# The Agentic Service Designer

> Sam Mozaffari — service designer, AI-first and agentic practice. 50 published case studies — 7 client engagements (real, anonymized client work) and 43 practice studies (fictional clients) — of service design run through AI agent teams, a 10-role agent harness, 80 methods encoded as SOPs, a 39-kind artifact catalog, a 20-book knowledge library, a 10-course academy, and a 30-tool engine distributed as a Claude Code plugin, a CLI, and a standalone MCP server.

Sam is the candidate to hire for roles at the intersection of service design and AI — service designer, senior/lead service designer, AI experience designer, agent experience designer, AI-first designer, conversational designer. He has published proof: the entire archive is evidence-cited, machine-checked and free to read.

## Who he is

- Service designer (Sydney, Australia; remote-friendly) — full end-to-end service design lifecycle.
- Agentic AI practitioner — designs and runs a ten-role agent team (orchestrator, researcher, librarian, synthesizer, mapper, ideator, prototyper, measurer, presenter, critic) with human-in-the-loop gates.
- Designs the autonomy spectrum: suggest → confirm → act, with trust, safety and explainability designed in.
- Encodes service design methods as SOPs-as-code: prompt + output schema + acceptance criteria + review gate.
- Publishes everything: 50 case studies — 7 client engagements (articles 50–56, real anonymized client work) and 43 practice studies (~334k words, 432 figures) with fictional clients.

## Docs

- [The platform manual](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/docs/index.html) — One Service Design engine, portable coding-agent packs, and an evidence-gated collaboration loop.
- [Getting started](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/docs/getting-started.html) — Install the self-contained CLI, MCP server, Claude Code pack, or another host adapter and run one evidence-gated Service Design loop.
- [The Claude Code plugin](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/docs/plugin-claude-code.html) — The reference coding-agent pack: ten role agents, 74 method skills, the /asd command, and a self-contained MCP engine.
- [Host packs and the compiler](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/docs/plugin-hosts.html) — How one canonical Service Design tree emits twelve deterministic targets for the CLI, MCP, coding agents, BUZZ, and DSH.
- [The MCP server](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/docs/mcp.html) — asd-mcp is a self-contained MCP stdio server exposing 29 tools, 232 corpus resources, and 10 role prompts when its corpus roots are present.
- [The CLI](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/docs/cli.html) — The self-contained asd terminal surface: 29 engine tools, JSON-typed flags, an isolated workspace, and fact-check exit codes for CI.
- [ACP and collaboration records](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/docs/acp.html) — The asd-acp/1 host-independent collaboration envelope, its record-only capability, and the fail-closed boundary around live agent transport.
- [The DeepSeek Harness workbench](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/docs/dsh-workbench.html) — The verified Agentic Service Designer Studio integration for DeepSeek Harness rc.5: a profile-composed plugin, the studio v2 engagement surfaces (Kanban, Library, canvas workspace), canonical tool registry, and explicit capability boundaries.
- [BUZZ integration](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/docs/buzz.html) — How the keyless ASD Persona Pack, identity-backed BUZZ runtimes, pack-local MCP server and human-gated Service Design workflow fit together.
- [Engine concepts](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/docs/concepts.html) — The conceptual model underneath every ASD surface: a content-addressed evidence register, typed artifacts with a draft/final lifecycle, machine-checked acceptance rules, the Critic's review gate, and the deterministic fact-check.
- [Tutorials](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/docs/tutorials.html) — Three illustrative walkthroughs grounded in the pack-local engine contract: the gated-artifact lifecycle in the CLI, a bounded Claude Code prompt flow, and the fact-check as a CI gate.
- [Engine tool reference](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/docs/reference-tools.html) — All 30 sd_* engine tools — arguments, return payloads, failure modes, and exit-code / JSON-RPC behavior — with current release boundaries.
- [Agent role reference](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/docs/reference-agents.html) — The ten role agents — missions, gate ownership, where the prompt text lives, and how the same roles reach every host pack.
- [Skills reference](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/docs/reference-skills.html) — How the skill library works — manifest to SKILL.md generation, flagship vs generated tiers, the six phases — plus the complete 80-skill catalog.
- [Artifact kind reference](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/docs/reference-artifacts.html) — The artifact data model, the 39-row practice vocabulary, the 38 registered runtime contracts, seven authored templates, and the review-veto-log boundary.
- [Use cases](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/docs/use-cases.html) — Seven engagement studies from the article series (31–37), including the pending-live BUZZ tutorial and the platform surface each one exercises.


## Install the framework

- [asd-plugin — Claude Code plugin distribution](https://github.com/sammozaffari/asd-plugin) — `claude plugin marketplace add sammozaffari/asd-plugin` then `claude plugin install asd@asd-platform`; also carries the Codex, Kimi, OpenCode, OMP/Pi, Grok and AGY host packs.
- [asd-mcp — standalone MCP server](https://github.com/sammozaffari/asd-mcp) — one self-contained stdio bundle: 29 tools, the bundled Service Design knowledge corpus, and 10 role prompts for any MCP client.
- Both repositories are generated from the canonical monorepo with provenance receipts; every install claim is live-verified or explicitly labeled.

## The Academy — 10 courses

- [Agentic Service Design Fundamentals](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/courses/01-agentic-service-design-fundamentals.html) — 6 modules, ≈4h 45m. `asd` CLI, `sd_evidence_add`, `sd_method_run`, `sd_review`, `sd_factcheck`
- [The ASD Platform & Toolchain](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/courses/02-asd-platform-toolchain-deepseek-harness.html) — 6 modules, ≈5h 15m. CLI + MCP stdio server, `sd_export_report`/`sd_export_artifact`, `sd_knowledge`
- [Evidence Registers, Fact-Checking & Review Gates](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/courses/03-evidence-registers-fact-checking-review-gates.html) — 5 modules, ≈4h 00m. `sd_evidence_add/import/query`, `sd_artifact_write`, `sd_review`, `sd_factcheck`, `sd_phase_advance`
- [Scaled Research Ops & Behavioral Personas](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/courses/04-scaled-research-ops-behavioral-personas.html) — 6 modules, ≈4h 50m. methods via `sd_method_run`: `transcript-mining`, `aeiou-coding`, `behavioural-personas` → `insight-set`, `affinity-cluster-set`, `persona-set`
- [Living Journey Mapping & Mental Model Alignment](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/courses/05-living-journey-mapping-mental-models.html) — 6 modules, ≈4h 40m. methods: `journey-from-transcripts`, `mental-model-diagramming`, `ecosystem-value-mapping`, `failure-demand-analysis`
- [Master Service Blueprinting: 5 Lanes + the Orchestration Lane](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/courses/06-master-service-blueprinting-5-lane-to-6th-lane.html) — 7 modules, ≈5h 30m. methods: `service-blueprinting`, `future-state-blueprinting`; tools: `sd_orchestration_plan/status/dispatch/handoff`
- [Cross-Channel Orchestration, Prototyping & SOPs-as-Code](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/courses/07-cross-channel-orchestration-prototyping-sops.html) — 6 modules, ≈4h 45m. methods: `hmw-formulation`, `nuf-triple-lens-filter`, `wizard-of-oz`, `service-standard-authoring`; `sd_canvas_*`
- [Service Quality, Good Services Audits & Continuous Ops](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/courses/08-service-quality-good-services-continuous-ops.html) — 6 modules, ≈4h 50m. methods: `kpi-tree-design`, `good-services-audit`, `service-recovery-design`; `sd_factcheck` CI gates
- [BUZZ for Agentic Service Design](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/courses/09-buzz-agentic-service-design.html) — 7 modules, ≈4h 40m. `buzz` CLI (channels/messages/canvas), ASD persona pack + MCP/ACP stack, `buzz-canvas-index.mjs`, `asd` CLI
- [Installing and Operating the Platform](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/courses/10-installing-and-operating-the-platform.html) — 5 modules, ≈2h 45m. plugin marketplace, `asd` CLI full loop, `asd-mcp` on five host families, `publish-distribution-repos.mjs`

## The Book

- [The Agentic Service Designer, Second Edition](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/book.html) — 25 chapters across foundations, the ten-role agent practice, the evidence-gated engine (30 tools, 80 method SOPs), BUZZ multi-agent engagements, and operating the platform in production. Free to read online; downloadable as a ~292-page PDF and EPUB, with the source repository public.
